p: Bracknell's town centre was rebuilt around The Lexicon, and 20 High Street puts MERKUR right in amongst the shops, restaurants and the cinema. Bracknell station is a short walk away, with trains to Reading and London Waterloo. Remember, it's an 18+ venue.

If you've got the family with you, Coral Reef waterworld has slides and pools to keep the kids happy for hours. The Look Out Discovery Centre, out in the woods towards Crowthorne, is a hands-on science centre with forest trails, and Swinley Forest nearby is popular for mountain biking and Go Ape. South Hill Park arts centre has shows, films and lovely gardens.
